sources.quote: la mayoría de casos para ejecución de hipotecas fueron radicados por la compañía neoyorquina Roosevelt Cayman Asset Company
sources.searcher_note: Earliest found. Court data: most federal foreclosure filings in PR were by Roosevelt Cayman and FDIC-as-Doral-receiver; real-estate share of federal civil cases went 8% (Jun 2014) to 59% (Feb 2016). No default-judgment rate.

sources.quote: investigation, most of the claims have been filed by Roosevelt Cayman Asset Company, a Rushmore affiliate.
sources.searcher_note: Cites El Nuevo Día: federal PR foreclosures jumped from 52 (2014) to 1,148 (2015) and 1,081 (2016), most filed by Roosevelt Cayman. Mentions its default-judgment motions after Maria, no rate.

sources.quote: Even after the hurricane, Roosevelt has filed motions for default judgment or eviction in the cases.
sources.searcher_note: Roosevelt had 289 active federal and 56 local foreclosure cases; PESP's Jim Baker says they serve by publication then ask for default judgment and mostly get it. No default rate or peer comparison.

sources.quote: while TPG affiliates Roosevelt Cayman and Bautista Cayman have pursued over 300 actions.
sources.searcher_note: Post-Maria actions incl. service by publication and default-judgment motions; also says Roosevelt stayed hundreds of suits Dec 2017-Mar 2018 after protests.
NYT: Roosevelt Cayman restarting and reopening foreclosure cases after the Fannie/Freddie moratorium ended May 31, 2018.

notes: Several sources name Roosevelt Cayman as the dominant federal-court foreclosure filer in Puerto Rico 2015-17 and describe it seeking default judgments. None found gives a share of 2015-25 federal foreclosures, a case count near 1,130, or a default-judgment rate vs other filers (52% vs 37%). Hedge Clippers cites an El Nuevo Día investigation that most federal claims were Roosevelt's; the El Nuevo Día article itself was not found. PESP (pestakeholder.org, 2018-01-26) repeats the Intercept 289/56 figures; not recorded separately. US District Court PR general order '20190516-ADC-Default-Judgment-Foreclosure-Cases.pdf' (prd.uscourts.gov) is a scanned PDF with no extractable text; could not quote. No coverage dated after 2026-06-30 found. No source disagreeing on default rates found.
